name: Electric Power Systems Analysis and Design
description: A course in electric power systems. Topics include overview of electric transmission and distribution networks; ac transmission lines and cable systems; fundamental principles of major power system components (generators, transformers and motors); characteristics and requirements of power system loads; power system operation and control; earthing and safety requirements; faults in power system and protection; design of industrial and commercial distribution for mission-critical facilities; reliability analysis, risk assessment, safety and maintainability considerations; power quality and interface issues with renewable and alternative energy sources.
